declarations.name: AuiMaskedInput
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI MaskedInput: `<aui-masked-input>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Visible label and accessible name.

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the label; it remains the accessible name.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Help text referenced by aria-describedby.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: Pattern: 9 digit, a letter, * letter or digit, custom token characters, \ escapes; anything else is a literal.

inputs.name: tokens
inputs.description: Custom tokens { pattern, transform?, description? }; override built-ins with the same character.

inputs.name: minLength
inputs.description: Raw characters needed for a complete value (default: every slot).

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Form field name (hidden input).

inputs.name: submit
inputs.description: What the hidden input and getFormValue() carry.

inputs.name: placeholder
inputs.description: Shown while empty and unfocused (default: the template with placeholder characters).

inputs.name: example
inputs.description: Example value read in the generated format hint.

inputs.name: formatHint
inputs.description: Replaces the generated format hint.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Empty value is invalid; shows the required indicator.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Disables the field.

inputs.name: readOnly
inputs.description: Focusable and submitted, not editable.

inputs.name: inputMode
inputs.description: Virtual keyboard hint (default numeric for digit-only masks).

inputs.name: autocomplete
inputs.description: Native autocomplete token.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Text direction of the value.

inputs.name: validate
inputs.type: ((value: string, context: { readonly formattedValue: string; readonly complete: boolean; }) => string | null)
inputs.description: Consumer validation (for example a checksum); return a message to mark the value invalid.

inputs.name: icons
inputs.description: Icon slot overrides.

inputs.name: validationTiming
inputs.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

inputs.name: placeholderChar
inputs.description: Character shown in empty slots while the template is visible.

inputs.name: showMaskOnFocus
inputs.description: Show the whole template while focused.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Message locale.

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: valueInput
outputs.description: The raw value changed: { value, formattedValue, complete, validity }.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: Focus left with a changed value.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error; cleared when the user edits.

methods.name: getFormValue
methods.description: Raw or formatted value, per submit.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear dirty/touched/submitted state.

accessibility.pattern: Native text input (textbox) with a programmatically associated format hint; no custom widget role.

limitations: Edits are applied through beforeinput, so the browser's undo and redo do not apply to the field (Ctrl+Z does nothing).
Each mask has one shape; optional trailing slots are expressed with minLength (for example IBAN lengths 15 to 34).
IME composition is re-parsed after the composition commits.
